metadataRaw.title: Decompress Your Neck at Home #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to decompress your neck at home using a pull up band.

This exercise will take pressure off the cervical spine and spinal discs, which may give neck pain relief within seconds. It's especially effective for herniated discs (bulging discs) that may be causing sharp, shooting pains. 

Let us know how it works for you!

Link to pull up band: https://amzn.to/3PqXFe5
